pages.title: K-Pop Hunter Birthday Bash
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Prepare a pop-inspired party look in K-Pop Hunter Birthday Bash. Choose clothing, accessories, and other styling details for the hunter's birthday celebration. Compare the available pieces and complete an outfit that brings the character's music-themed appearance into the party setting.

pages.title: Bike Obby Draw Pencil
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Draw missing sections of a course in Bike Obby Draw Pencil. Connect gaps between platforms with pencil paths so the character can continue without falling. Move and jump through the finished sections, adapting the next drawing to the obstacles ahead.

pages.title: Robbie: Stand on the Right Color!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Find safe footing in Robbie: Stand on the Right Color! Watch the color displayed on screen and move onto a matching floor tile before the other sections disappear. Keep reacting to each new color to prevent Robbie from falling out of the round.

pages.title: Okay
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Clear a board with one planned shot in Okay. Draw a line that moves and rebounds through the objects after you release it. Predict the trajectory so the single attempt touches every required element and leaves the playfield empty.

pages.title: Tag Run
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Pass an explosive to another runner in Tag Run. Chase and tag opponents, then escape before the bomb goes off, using teleport pads and spring jumps to change the pursuit. Share the controls with up to four local players across six different map settings.

pages.title: Ocean Rescue
pages.creator: TREE Studios
pages.description: Free trapped sea creatures in Ocean Rescue. Guide Squiddy's gun with the mouse or a finger and shoot at the water bubbles holding the ocean's inhabitants. Continue the rescue journey to release the squid's companions and meet more creatures along the way.

pages.title: Smash The Bottle
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Break glass targets in Smash The Bottle. Click the bottles to shatter them and build points through the arcade challenge. Look for opportunities to keep the hits coming and form larger combinations as more bottles are presented for destruction.

pages.title: Hidden Object: Clues and Mysteries
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Search detailed indoor scenes in Hidden Object: Clues and Mysteries. Move sideways through the locations and zoom in to examine small details around the room. Find the concealed objects needed for the detective's investigation and continue through the available mysteries.

pages.title: Car Park Simulator
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Maneuver into marked bays in Car Park Simulator. Steer around obstacles and through confined spaces, lining up the vehicle with its target parking position. Complete seventy-two layouts using the keyboard or on-screen driving controls to handle each approach.

pages.title: Stick Ninja Survival
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Dodge monsters and their projectiles in Stick Ninja Survival. Move the fighter away from incoming threats while its attacks happen automatically. Stay alive through the encounters as the red-moon setting fills with more enemies to avoid.

pages.title: Checkers Deluxe Edition
pages.creator: Monstera Games
pages.description: Capture opposing pieces in Checkers Deluxe Edition. Take turns moving diagonally and jump over an enemy piece when the square behind it is free. Plan exchanges that protect your own checkers while working toward removing every piece on the other side.

pages.title: Battle Tanks Firestorm
pages.creator: DarkPlay
pages.description: Defend a base with armored vehicles in Battle Tanks Firestorm. Choose from more than fifteen tank types, move through combat stages, and fire at the attackers. Improve armor and other vehicle features as you prepare a stronger tank for later engagements.

pages.title: Bike Stunt Racing Legend
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Race a motorcycle through stunt routes in Bike Stunt Racing Legend. Keep the bike balanced across rolling ramps and reach the finish ahead of the computer rider. Maintaining speed can pressure the rival into mistakes, but the course still requires controlled landings.

pages.title: Tropical Match
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Join Coco on an island puzzle journey in Tropical Match. Swap fruit and other treasures into groups of at least three to clear the board. Build larger combinations for bonuses while progressing through levels themed around flowers, birds, and tropical produce.

pages.title: Jump Girl 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Climb a growing food tower in Jump Girl 3D. Time jumps onto incoming blocks of tofu and keep the character near the center of each landing. Watch both sides for the next obstacle as the bouncy stack rises beneath the girl.

pages.title: Merge Shooter
pages.creator: Byte Blasters
pages.description: Strengthen a line of galactic defenses in Merge Shooter. Combine matching turrets to create stronger weapons and fire on invading aliens. Use special powers when the enemies put pressure on the formation, then continue developing the guns for later stages.

pages.title: King Kong Chaos
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Reach a guarded prize in King Kong Chaos. Cross pixel platforms while avoiding spiked balls and barrels hurled by the giant gorilla. Collect a pickaxe to break incoming barrels and grab the golden banana needed to complete the stage.

pages.title: Spring Tile Master
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Collect matching sets in Spring Tile Master. Choose tiles showing flowers, leaves, or insects and bring three identical pieces together in the stack. The stack holds only nine tiles, so plan each selection and shuffle when needed to clear the whole board.

pages.title: Lorenzo the Runner
pages.creator: Manvel Azarjan
pages.description: Run and jump through a city in Lorenzo the Runner. Cross four stages set in three different environments, avoiding the enemies waiting along the platform routes. Use the directional keys to position Lorenzo and time each jump toward the next landing.

pages.title: Christmas Memory
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reveal festive pairs in Christmas Memory. Flip a card, remember its picture, and find the identical partner elsewhere on the board. Clear every pair before time expires as later layouts introduce more demanding arrangements of Christmas symbols.

pages.title: Cyberpunk Surgery Master
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Rebuild a damaged mechanical body in Cyberpunk Surgery Master. Use the available tools to repair the robot's limbs and reconnect its parts. Work through the procedure until the separate sections form a restored body and the virtual operation is complete.

pages.title: Pixel Knight Adventure
pages.creator: hexapp
pages.description: Fight through a pixel world in Pixel Knight Adventure. Move and jump past enemies, strike with the attack control, and launch fireballs when available. Defeat the opponents along the route to gain new abilities and continue the warrior's adventure.

pages.title: Ibiza Pool Party
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Help two princesses get ready for a holiday event in Ibiza Pool Party. Choose makeover details and outfits for Elsa and Ariel before their summer celebration. Coordinate the available fashion pieces to finish both characters' appearances for the poolside gathering.

pages.title: Boxes Wizard
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Cross puzzle rooms with teleporting magic in Boxes Wizard. Push boxes and swap places with them to create routes through forty levels. Use the movement keys and Space to reposition the wizard around obstacles and reach areas that ordinary walking cannot access.

pages.title: Ball Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Organize colored spheres in Ball Sort Puzzle. Move the top ball from one tube into another with enough room, placing it on an identical color. Use the spare capacity to rearrange the tubes until every group of matching balls is together.

pages.title: Alien Princess
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style two characters from different habitats in Alien Princess. Choose forest-inspired clothing made around vines and feathers for one princess, then explore pearl, algae, and coral-inspired options for the other. Complete both outfits with details suited to their contrasting worlds.

pages.title: Zoo Tile - Match Puzzle Game
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Build an animal attraction through matching puzzles in Zoo Tile - Match Puzzle Game. Select three identical tiles to clear sets and earn coins. Spend the rewards on animals, decorations, and buildings, developing the zoo's landscape as more puzzle stages are completed.

pages.title: Emilys Home Sweet Home
pages.creator: Gamehouse
pages.description: Help the O'Malleys protect their home in Emilys Home Sweet Home. Prepare the food visitors request by selecting ingredients and serving the completed orders. Keep the service moving through Emily's restaurant tasks as the family works toward securing its dream house.

pages.title: Halloween Ghost Balls
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Guide a growing group through a spooky course in Halloween Ghost Balls. Hold to steer the ghost balls along the route and collect green flames to increase their number. Complete the task set for the current level before moving into another Halloween-themed challenge.

pages.title: Merge Monsters Army
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Prepare a stronger fighting force in Merge Monsters Army. Spend gold on additional creatures and combine identical monsters into more powerful versions. Use the resulting army against the opposing group, then continue unlocking and merging units for another battle.

pages.title: MAX AXE
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description: Throw axes at the center of targets in MAX AXE. Aim for the bull's-eye to gain higher scores and the rewards associated with accurate hits. Progress through checkpoints to unlock more weapons and explore the available throwing modes.

pages.title: Funny Heroes Emergency
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Treat battle-worn characters in Funny Heroes Emergency. Examine their injuries and use the appropriate items to handle each problem in turn. After the care steps, improve the heroes' appearance so they are ready for their next fictional mission.

pages.title: Wood Block Puzzle 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Fit wooden shapes onto a grid in Wood Block Puzzle 2. Place the available set of three pieces to complete horizontal or vertical lines, clearing space for the next group. Keep room for later shapes while increasing the score through completed rows.

pages.title: Ragdoll Duel: Boxing
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Trade punches with a wobbling opponent in Ragdoll Duel: Boxing. Move, crouch, and strike with the stick-figure boxer, saving a charged Super Punch for a useful opening. Win two rounds against the computer or a second player to take the bout.

pages.title: Body Race
pages.creator: Gismart
pages.description: Meet a runway target during the obstacle course in Body Race. Guide the automatically running character left or right to collect food and fitness items that change the result. Finish with the required target to unlock more outfits for the model.

pages.title: Ellie Get Ready with Me
pages.creator: Top Girl Games
pages.description: Help a fashion vlogger prepare a daily look in Ellie Get Ready with Me. Work through the character's morning beauty and clothing choices as she shows viewers her routine. Complete the makeup and outfit to finish the ready-for-the-day video.

pages.title: 456 impostor
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Survive as a numbered astronaut in 456 impostor. Jump onto red-suited enemies to defeat them and clear the route through the stages. Every tenth level introduces an endless-running section with more opponents to eliminate along the way.

pages.title: Fruit Slide Reps
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Plan a repeating cut in Fruit Slide Reps. Draw a swipe that first hits one fruit, then watch that slice repeat through the level. Choose a trajectory that eventually reaches all the fruit while avoiding the bombs mixed into the arrangement.

pages.title: Magic Piano Tiles
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Follow twelve songs and rhythms in Magic Piano Tiles. Press the corresponding arrow key, or tap a target, when an approaching tile reaches its mark. Keep the inputs aligned with the music as successive tiles arrive across the play area.

pages.title: Create Balloons
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Fill containers with a ball-making machine in Create Balloons. Click the small production bucket to release more balls into the scene, managing the flow into the available space. Continue filling the required container to complete the factory task.

pages.title: Instruments for Kids
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Try four musical instruments in Instruments for Kids. Select a piano, xylophone, harp, or drum set and use the mouse or touch controls to play its notes. Explore the different sounds and create your own sequence without following a required score.

pages.title: Brutal Zombies
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Survive armed arena battles in Brutal Zombies. Move around the area, fire at incoming undead, and reload before another group reaches you. Defeat the waves to win encounters and unlock more weapons for later fights.

pages.title: Fun Halloween Memory
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Find spooky picture pairs in Fun Halloween Memory. Flip tiles to reveal their images and remember where each matching partner is hidden. Clear all the cards across fourteen levels, aiming to complete the arrangements with fewer turns.

pages.title: Women Wrestling Fight Revolution Fighting Games
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Enter character bouts in Women Wrestling Fight Revolution Fighting Games. Use the on-screen controls to direct a wrestler through fights against other competitors. Time the available attacks around the opponent's movement as you work toward winning the encounter.

pages.title: Head to head soccer
pages.creator: GameZing
pages.description: Compete in oversized-headed football in Head to head soccer. Control the player with the arrow keys and score against the opponent across the available modes. Practice in friendly matches before taking on the game's leagues and cups at higher challenge levels.

pages.title: 4x4 Suv Jeep Games 2020
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Drive a four-wheel-drive vehicle over uneven routes in 4x4 Suv Jeep Games 2020. Use the left and right controls to guide the jeep through the winding tracks. Keep its direction under control as the off-road course changes ahead.

pages.title: Space Invaders Remake
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Defend against formations of alien attackers in Space Invaders Remake. Move the ship with the mouse or directional keys and shoot through the incoming waves. Continue clearing invaders as another formation arrives to threaten the defender's position.

pages.title: Battalion Commander
pages.creator: IriySoft
pages.description: Lead a squad through hostile territory in Battalion Commander. Move the group with the mouse or a finger, rescue captured soldiers, and add their support to the fight. Purchase upgrades and trigger special skills when the enemy pressure makes them useful.

pages.title: Hidden Funny Alphabet
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Search illustrated scenes for concealed letters in Hidden Funny Alphabet. Inspect the picture and click the alphabet characters hidden among its details. Keep checking the remaining areas until the required letters have been found and the search is complete.

pages.title: Endless Toy Car Racing 2k20
pages.creator: toplight studio
pages.description: Race miniature-style vehicles in Endless Toy Car Racing 2k20. Drive through stunt-focused courses, taking cars onto ramps and working through the available challenges. Control the approach to each section as the route climbs into elevated driving areas.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Tattoo Procedure
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Create two body-art designs in Dotted Girl Tattoo Procedure. Help the character choose drawings, prepare the skin, and color the applied designs. Complete the game's finishing steps with cream and a patch to end her virtual tattoo appointment.

pages.title: Baby Boss Photo Shoot
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Prepare a young character for the camera in Baby Boss Photo Shoot. Compare looks inspired by beachwear, skating, office clothes, hip-hop, and superheroes. Choose the outfit and makeover details that suit the photo session before finishing the baby's appearance.

pages.title: Halloween Defence
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Stop incoming pumpkins in Halloween Defence. Click or tap the attackers as they arrive from different sides of the screen. Keep shifting attention between directions so the next pumpkin is destroyed before it reaches the defended area.

pages.title: Stickman Parkour Speed 2020
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Race through urban obstacle routes in Stickman Parkour Speed 2020. Use the mouse to guide the runner while competing with computer-controlled players. Work through a hundred levels, keeping the character moving across the buildings toward the end of each course.

pages.title: Almond And Apple Cake
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help a mother prepare a family dessert in Almond And Apple Cake. Follow the kitchen instructions to work through the recipe and combine its ingredients. Complete the cake-making stages so the finished almond-and-apple treat is ready for the children's holiday.

pages.title: Parking Jam 3D
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Untangle a crowded vehicle layout in Parking Jam 3D. Choose a car that can move and send it out, opening space for another vehicle to leave. Plan the departure order until the whole parking lot has been cleared of its traffic jam.

pages.title: Angry shooting Emoji
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Launch emoji projectiles in Angry shooting Emoji. Pull back the slingshot to choose a trajectory, then release toward the targets and their supporting structures. Adjust the next shot according to what remains standing after the first impact.

pages.title: Blackjack Game
pages.creator: Game-Devs
pages.description: Play virtual card hands against a dealer in Blackjack Game. Choose whether to take another card while keeping the total at or below twenty-one. Finish closer to the target than the dealer without exceeding it to win the hand.

pages.title: Kart Karting Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore racing pictures in Kart Karting Slide. Select one of three kart images and a puzzle mode, then move the scrambled sections into their proper positions. Compare the vehicle and track details to identify which neighboring section should slide next.

pages.title: FZ Monster Track
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Drive large vehicles across hilly two-dimensional courses in FZ Monster Track. Choose among five trucks and control the approach to slopes, jumps, and uneven landing areas. Work through more than sixty levels while keeping the selected vehicle moving along the track.

pages.title: Baby Halen Winter Dress Up
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Create a cold-weather outfit in Baby Halen Winter Dress Up. Browse the available clothing and pair warm pieces with matching accessories for the character. Compare combinations and finish the winter look with the details you want Halen to wear.

pages.title: Airport Airplane Parking Game 3D
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Guide an aircraft into a marked bay in Airport Airplane Parking Game 3D. Control the plane through the airport's parking layout, accounting for the space required by its larger body. Line up the approach and complete the ground maneuver into the designated position.

pages.title: Impossible Car Parking
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Complete demanding parking layouts in Impossible Car Parking. Drive with the directional keys, adjust the vehicle's angle, and approach the target space carefully. Work through the course's turns and confined sections to finish each parking assignment.

pages.title: Space Mission Jigsaw
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Assemble science-fiction scenes in Space Mission Jigsaw. Choose from twelve pictures and a layout with twenty-five, forty-nine, or one hundred pieces. Match edges and space-themed details to reconnect the scattered sections into the finished mission image.

pages.title: Ice Queen Back Treatment
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Treat a royal character's skin in Ice Queen Back Treatment. Use the game's tools to address bumps, redness, and wounds across her back. Finish the virtual care sequence with a hot-stone treatment after the affected areas have been cleaned and handled.

pages.title: Drive Boat
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Carry travelers along a river in Drive Boat. Click to start or stop the boat, collecting every waiting passenger and delivering them to the destination. Time the movement around other boats crossing the water so the trip continues without a collision.

pages.title: A Thanksgiving Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Match festive pieces in A Thanksgiving Match 3. Form groups of at least three identical Thanksgiving items to remove them and earn points. Keep the side gauge from dropping too low by finding new combinations in the changing board.

pages.title: Sliding Panda
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Collect scattered coins on a snowy route in Sliding Panda. Guide the panda through each stage and jump over the snow obstacles ahead. Use the directional or touch controls to keep moving while reaching the remaining coins along the path.

pages.title: Jungle Survival Jurassic Park
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Survive encounters with prehistoric creatures in Jungle Survival Jurassic Park. Choose a campaign or multiplayer battle, move through the jungle, and use firearms against the dinosaurs. Switch weapons, reload, crouch, or sprint as the enemies close in around the character.

pages.title: Yummy Cupcake Coloring
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Decorate dessert pictures in Yummy Cupcake Coloring. Pick one of eight cupcake drawings and apply colors to its icing, wrapper, and other details. Finish the design and use the camera option to download a copy of the completed image.

pages.title: Monster Color Match
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Swap colorful creatures into matching lines in Monster Color Match. Exchange a monster with a neighboring piece to create a horizontal or vertical chain of at least three matching colors. Clear those groups and look for another useful move in the resulting arrangement.

pages.title: Racing Cartoons Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Reassemble illustrated racing scenes in Racing Cartoons Jigsaw. Choose from twelve images and select a difficulty before placing the scattered pieces. Match the characters, cars, and background sections until the selected cartoon race picture is complete.

pages.title: Kinder Surprise
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Open a chocolate surprise in Kinder Surprise. Click to unwrap the egg, remove the chocolate, and reach the yellow container hidden inside. Open that capsule to reveal the toy, then try another egg to discover a different surprise.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Learns Manners
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Hazel learn everyday behavior in Baby Hazel Learns Manners. Join her mother through activities that include morning exercise and kitchen etiquette. Interact with the characters and objects to guide Hazel through the lessons presented during the day.

pages.title: Towing Train
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Move a heavy load toward a station in Towing Train. Control a tractor attached to a train and pull it along the rail route. Keep the vehicle advancing through the towing challenge until the connected train has covered the required distance.

pages.title: Charm Farm
pages.creator: Nevosoft
pages.description: Restore a magical woodland in Charm Farm. Cast spells, direct the Shmoos, and cultivate unusual plants and creatures around the forest. Use the available activities to develop the enchanted setting and continue discovering more of its living inhabitants.

pages.title: Stickman Ragdoll Crash Fun
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Send a stick figure into stunt crashes in Stickman Ragdoll Crash Fun. Launch the character through impacts with walls, boxes, and explosive objects, watching the physics produce different results. Experiment with another attempt to create a larger chain of collisions and airborne tricks.

pages.title: Hand Doctor
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Treat a character's injured palm in Hand Doctor. Turn the hand to inspect both sides and use the available tools on its cuts and wounds. Work through cream application and stitching activities to complete the virtual treatment sequence.

pages.title: Fancy Birds Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Build bird pictures from scattered sections in Fancy Birds Puzzle. Select an easy, medium, or hard layout and reconnect the image pieces by their outlines and details. There is no countdown, allowing you to complete each bird scene at your own pace.

pages.title: Gold Rush
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Develop and protect settlements in Gold Rush. Construct lands while rival players try to damage the buildings and take the gold. Buy shields for protection and hire workers who continue producing in-game gold while you are away from the game.

pages.title: 2048 Challenges
pages.creator: Yupi.io
pages.description: Combine sliding numbers in 2048 Challenges. Move the board in one of four directions to merge equal values into a larger tile. Reach 2048 to win, then continue toward higher values if you want to extend the same number-building puzzle.

pages.title: Princesses Adventures
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Give Emma, Mia, and Audrey action-inspired costumes in Princesses Adventures. Help the princesses move beyond their usual royal wardrobes by choosing outfits influenced by survival-adventure characters. Compare the available clothing and finish a separate adventurous look for each girl.

pages.title: Snowwars.io
pages.creator: Jetti Games AB
pages.description: Grow and fight in a snowy multiplayer arena in Snowwars.io. Collect snow to enlarge the snowman, then throw snowballs at other players to contest the field. Keep gathering resources while choosing when to challenge the opponents moving nearby.

pages.title: Ski Hero
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Descend a wintry mountain in Ski Hero. Steer past the obstacles along the slope and keep the skier clear of collisions. Gather banners for extra points as you continue downhill and try to extend the distance of the run.

pages.title: Halloween Archer
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Shoot seasonal targets in Halloween Archer. Aim the bow with the mouse or by dragging a finger, then release an arrow toward the objects. Destroy every Halloween element required by the stage and line up the next shot around the remaining targets.

pages.title: Slow Down
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Manipulate the pace of an obstacle course in Slow Down. Reduce the game speed when a dangerous block approaches, then time the movement through the available opening. Continue upward by choosing when to slow the action and when to advance past the next barrier.

pages.title: Legendary Warrior GR
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Battle goblins with a bow in Legendary Warrior GR. Aim arrows through the stage and strike the enemies positioned around the scene. Account for the route of each projectile as you clear opponents and continue the warrior's campaign against the dark army.

pages.title: Air Wolves Flight
pages.creator: TopSoft UG
pages.description: Pilot a vintage fighter through aerial battles in Air Wolves Flight. Fly, attack enemy aircraft, and evade threats while trying to survive the dogfights. The First World War setting provides early planes for the squadron's continuing combat in the sky.

pages.title: Wild Animals Memory
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Clear animal picture pairs in Wild Animals Memory. Turn cards over, remember their positions, and select identical partners before the countdown ends. Four levels grow more demanding as you work toward finishing the arrangements quickly and earning more points.

pages.title: Doll Creator Fashion Looks
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create and style characters in Doll Creator Fashion Looks. Build a doll first, then choose outfits for different occasions in its life. Compare the available clothing and accessories to give the finished character a new look for each event.

pages.title: Flower Spring Ball 2
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Prepare Christine for a seasonal dance in Flower Spring Ball 2. Start with colorful makeup, then choose accessories and clothing that suit the celebration. Coordinate the beauty details with the completed outfit before finishing her preparations for the spring ball.

pages.title: Kitty Fashion Day
pages.creator: Daria Games
pages.description: Help a feline character change her appearance in Kitty Fashion Day. Begin with a dress, then compare shoes and accessories that complement it. Put together the selected pieces to complete the kitty's new look for her day out.
